LanguageData.RT_T15_Vehicle.label: T-15 "Armata"
LanguageData.RT_T15_Vehicle.description:
The T-15 "Armata" IFV is a new generation of unique medium-sized tracked in the Russian Federation, with unparalleled protection and advanced digital command system. capable of adapting to a variety of turret modules.

<color=#bb8f04>Crew:</color> Driver x1, Gunner x1, Commander x1, Passenger x8
<color=#bb8f04>Fuel:</color> Chemfuel

<color=#b0e0e6>CE Ammo:</color> 
30x165mm（Main Gun）
9M133"Kornet" Missile（Missile Launcher）
7.62x54mmR（Coaxial MG）
